To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

the pattern of global expansion in East Asia is associated with the intensification of production in the domestic market and the intensification of trade in the region, particularly for Japanese manufacturing firms with operations in East Asia.

(i) Japanese firms expanding operations in the region are more likely to intensify their domestic operations and export/import activities with East Asia than those not expanding operations; (ii) this is more pronounced in the latter period; (iii) the pattern is similar in both MNEs and non-MNEs; and (iv) the pattern is robust to different specifications of the model.

Japanese manufacturing firms expanding operations in the East Asian region tend to increase employment and the number and size of domestic establishments and intensify export and import activities with the region in line with the expansion of their operations in East Asia.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the relationship between the pattern of internationalization and the pattern of domestic operations of firms.
the relationship between the expansion of operations in East Asia and the pattern of global and domestic operations of Japanese manufacturing firms.
a new phenomenon of the globalizing behavior of firms, which is called “expanding fragmentation of production,” and its implications for domestic operations.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that

the pattern of global operations of Japanese manufacturing firms in East Asia is changing from the traditional pattern to the new pattern, which is characterized by the further fragmentation of production in the region and domestic operations.
the globalizing corporate activities in East Asia are associated with the expansion of domestic operations and international activities of Japanese manufacturing MNEs and non-MNEs alike.
the expanding fragmentation of production in East Asia has been accompanied by the expansion and diversification of the domestic operations of Japanese manufacturing firms.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the expansion of production in East Asia by Japanese manufacturing firms has been a major driver for the expansion of domestic operations and international activities in Japan.

the expansion of operations in East Asia by Japanese manufacturing firms is associated with the intensification of the production fragmentation in East Asia and the further expansion of domestic operations in Japan.
the expansion of operations in East Asia has been accompanied with a further expansion of the production process in Japan and the intensification of export/import activities in East Asia.
The main takeaway from our work is that

Japanese manufacturing firms are expanding operations in East Asian economies by further intensifying the division of labor in their domestic operations and in their international trade with the region.
the expansion of production in East Asia has been associated with the further fragmentation of the production process of Japanese firms.

the pattern of global expansion of Japanese firms has changed in the sense that the firms have increasingly expanded operations in the region and intensified domestic operations and international activities with the region.
